title: Kid Thomas and his clarinetists
summary: Barnes played with Kid Thomas early on; they list clarinetists in Thomas's band, including Paul Barnes.

story.theme_name: Who was in the band: naming sidemen and personnel
story.community_name: Who played in the band: reciting personnel

blocks.x: How about Kid Thomas in those days? Did you play much with Thomas in the early days?

Yeah I played pretty good with Thomas in the early days. I played cards with them quite a while. I don't remember Thomas having any other clarinet play. Just late, just a couple of years back, he's been having different one playing.
I don't remember anybody else playing clarinets. Always been saxophone playing with him lately.
I can't think of anybody except for Paul O.
He had, let's see, he had Wash with him one time. That's right, Wash was with him. Then after come on this boy Hill with him, how do you call him? Or Al? Maniel Paul. Yeah.
And he's had Paul Barnes with him. That's what Paul was with him. He had Reuben Wrighty with him for a while too.
What kind of a trumpet player was he in the early days, in the twenties?
Well, I tell you, Thomas is partly the same to me. Yeah, he's partly the same to me. He might have fell back a little. About this. All right. I've got it.
